qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the TCI control unit mounting screws?
What is the torque specification for mounting screws on all models in the Electronic Shift Units section?
What is the torque specification for the crankshaft sensor on timing case cover?
Which components in this section use the same 5.0 Nm torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The angle impulse sensor on cylinder head and the crankshaft sensor on timing case cover both use 5.0 Nm (ft. lbs.)

qa_pairs.question: What is the highest torque specification listed in the Electronic Shift Units section?
qa_pairs.answer: 20 Nm (ft. lbs.) for all models in the general specification row
